stance_basis: paraphrase states committee went on record removing all consideration of moving General Mitchell Field to an alternate site, supporting its continued use and expansion
summary: SEWRPC's Technical Advisory Committee formally went on record opposing any relocation of General Mitchell Field to an alternate site, affirming that Mitchell Field will remain the region's scheduled air carrier airport with future expansion limited to presently county-owned land. This position supports the rationale for the proposed Airport Spur Freeway project by confirming the airport's permanence and the need for improved ground access. No response from an agency or preparer was directed at this specific mention.
